papers.title: HBM Is Not All You Need: Efficient Disaggregated LLM Serving across Memory-heterogeneous Accelerators
papers.abstract: LLM inference comprises a compute-bound prefill phase and a memory-bound decode phase, and recent systems disaggregate them onto separate hardware. papers.title: The Verbose Context Problem in Medical Records
papers.abstract: The verbose context problem occurs when structured concepts have token-inefficient textual representations. This bottleneck is acute in population health: cohort-level analysis of longitudinal patient records requires reasoning over thousands of medically-coded events, often exceeding 400K tokens in total. We present PopMedQA, a benchmark isolating this problem through computational tasks on groups of longitudinal patient records.
